title: Database capacity planning
description: Learn about Database capacity planning. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Database capacity planning** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with database capacity planning.

items: Understand the fundamental principles of database capacity planning
Learn practical applications and use cases
Identify common pitfalls and how to avoid them
Apply best practices in your daily work

data.text: Understanding database capacity planning is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with database capacity planning, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
